managers can delete others.name: managers can delete others
managers can delete others.using: ((select app.has_role('owner')) or ((select app.has_role('admin')) and role <> 'owner')) and id <> (select auth.uid())

editors can add items to drafts.name: editors can add items to drafts
editors can add items to drafts.withCheck:
(select app.has_role('owner', 'admin', 'buyer')) and exists (
  select 1 from public.launches l
  where l.id = launch_id and l.status = 'draft' and (l.created_by = (select auth.uid()) or (select app.has_role('owner', 'admin')))
)
